what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Niger in Algeria: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 200 Nigerien asylum seekers in Algeria, 0.9% of all asylum seekers from Niger.
Refugees from Niger, a separate group, live mostly in Mali, Nigeria, Benin and Chad.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Niger in every year from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Niger in 2007 and 2008 and, with JNIM, from 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2007 at 66 asylum seekers and fell to a low in 2010.
The figure was at its highest, 220, at the end of 2024; the main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Algeria.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Algeria only.
